acceptance_criteria: A `Parameter` record with `name: String`, `kind: ParamKind` (`Model` | `User`), `value: f64`, `unit: String` (free text for now, e.g. `"mm"`, `"deg"`, or empty), and `comment: String`. `Document::parameters()` returns them in creation order.

`Document::add_model_param(value, unit) -> String` creates a `Model` parameter named `d<N>`. N starts at 0, increases by 1 per call, and is never reused, even after a rename or deletion. If `d<N>` is already taken (for example, a user parameter named `d2`), N skips forward to the next free name. Test: three calls give `d0`, `d1`, `d2`; renaming `d1` to `width` and then calling again gives `d3`; with a user parameter `d4` existing, the next call gives `d5`.

`Document::add_user_param(name, value, unit) -> Result<(), ModelError>` rejects a duplicate name and an invalid name. A valid name matches `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`, which keeps it usable in M2-08 expressions.

`Document::rename_param(old, new) -> Result<(), ModelError>` validates `new` the same way and rejects a duplicate. It updates every `FeatureKind` reference (`Extrude.depth`, `Revolve.angle_deg`), so after the rename `dirty_after_param_change(new)` returns the same features that `dirty_after_param_change(old)` returned before it. Test with the existing `block_and_shaft` fixture.

`Document::set_param(name, value)` and `param(name)` keep working for existing callers. `set_param` on an unknown name creates a `User` parameter with an empty unit, so all existing tests pass unchanged. `Document::set_param_comment(name, comment)` returns `UnknownParameter` for unknown names.
New `ModelError` variants (e.g. `DuplicateParameter`, `InvalidParameterName`) implement `Display` with a clear message. No panics on any input.
No new dependencies; no `unsafe`; `swx-core` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` passes.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
